app.name: Trip Hub
app.tagline: Plan group trips and split expenses with friends effortlessly
app.footer: Built for friend groups in Bangladesh • All amounts in whole BDT (৳)

createTrip.title: Create a new trip
createTrip.subtitle: Enter the trip name and your name, then share the link with friends
createTrip.pinHint: Helps you reclaim your name if you clear browser data or switch phones

joinByLink.title: Join a trip
joinByLink.subtitle: Paste the shared trip link or slug code from your friend below

whoAreYou.title: Who are you?
whoAreYou.subtitle: Pick your existing name or join as a new member on this trip
whoAreYou.reclaimTitle: Already on this trip? Tap your name to rejoin
whoAreYou.emojiLabel: Emoji tag (helps tell same-named friends apart)
whoAreYou.lockedNotice: This trip is locked. New members cannot join, but existing members can still reclaim their name above.

tripPage.shareSubtitle: Share this link on WhatsApp or Messenger (no login needed)
tripPage.addGuestTitle: Add a guest member (friend without the app)
tripPage.renameTitle: Rename or update emoji for a member
tripPage.lockTripHint: Locking prevents new members, guests, or edits.
tripPage.nextStepsBody: Downloadable daily cost sheets and shareable summary images come in Step 7.

money.leftoverNote: Any integer rounding leftover (1–2 ৳) goes to the payer.
money.allSettled: Everyone is settled up! No pending debts.
money.settlementSubtitle: Record direct repayments between friends (kept separate from trip expenses)
money.duplicateWarningBody: An expense with the same amount on the same day already exists:
money.confirmDuplicateLabel: I confirm this is a separate expense (save anyway)
money.activityLogSubtitle: Immutable record of every expense, settlement, edit, and soft-delete

aiParser.cardSubtitle: Type an expense in natural Bangla or Banglish—review and edit on the Confirm Card before saving
aiParser.inputPlaceholder: e.g., রাতের খাবার ১২০০ টাকা করিম দিয়েছে সবাই / CNG 450 tk Tanvir paid for Karim and Tanvir
aiParser.confirmCardNote: Review or edit any field below, then tap 'Confirm & Save Expense'.
aiParser.errMissingAmount: Could not find a whole-taka amount (e.g., write 1200 tk or ১২০০ টাকা).
aiParser.errRateLimited: Too many parse requests! Please wait and try again
aiParser.errGeneric: Could not parse that text. Please try again or use the manual form below.

planning.votingSubtitle: Where should the group go? Propose options and vote (1 vote per member)
planning.itinerarySubtitle: Simple daily plan of activities for the trip

shareExport.cardSubtitle: Share a public read-only trip summary or download the full daily cost sheet
shareExport.publicSummaryTitle: Public Read-Only Summary Page (No Money Details)
shareExport.publicSummaryHint: Shows only the destination, member names, and itinerary—never exposes expenses or balances.
shareExport.costSheetHint: Includes per-day totals, per-person daily & overall totals, and simplified who-owes-whom:
shareExport.privacyNotice: For privacy, no expense or balance details are shown on this public summary page.

errors.invalid_input: Please fill in the required fields properly.
errors.duplicate_name: Someone with this name is already on the trip! Reclaim your name from the list above or add a last initial.
errors.trip_not_found: No trip was found for that link or code.
errors.trip_locked: This trip is locked and cannot be modified.
errors.not_creator: Only the trip creator can perform this action.
errors.invalid_amount: Amount must be a positive whole-taka integer.
errors.invalid_shares: Split shares do not match (select at least 1 member for Equal, match exact total for Exact, or sum to 100% for Percent).
errors.same_member_settlement: Payer and receiver cannot be the same member.
errors.unauthorized: Please join or select your name on this trip first.
errors.duplicate_expense_warning: A matching expense with the same amount on the same day already exists! Check 'I confirm this is a separate expense' in the form to save anyway.
errors.cross_trip_option: That destination vote option does not belong to this trip.
errors.duplicate_option: That destination option is already on the list!
